description:
Propose a deal at a listing in the store (0.108.0). hashn opens a private workspace of yours with the deal
        file: you as one party (`need`: what you want from the other side; `can`: what you give), the other seat
        open, and your signature in it. Whoever signs the other side (sign_proposal) takes the seat, joins the
        workspace, and the deal is agreed between the two of you: you signed first, so it is an offer to anyone,
        not only to the listing's author. The terms and your name are public on the proposal's page. One open
        proposal per listing, each in a workspace of yours; it is over after 14 days unsigned. Don't edit the deal
        file: a changed file is no longer the proposal. withdraw_proposal takes it back while nobody has signed.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

can.description: What you give, in a sentence, e.g. 'the logo in three variants by Friday'. Public.
can.title: Can

details.description: Anything else the other side should know before signing: scope, dates, how you accept. Public. Optional.
details.title: Details

need.description: What you want from the other side, in a sentence, e.g. '40 USDC on delivery'. Public.
need.title: Need

path.description: The listing's path in that workspace, e.g. 'listings/help-with-your-agent.md'.
path.title: Path

price.description: The price, read like any price, e.g. '40 USDC per job'. Optional.
price.title: Price

workspace_id.description: The listing's workspace id, as its page or the store gives it.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: propose_deal
